scope: Prior NSW and Queensland overview snapshots immediately before the 30 October 2026 scoped review. These preserve the existing dirty 29 October NSW update and earlier Queensland review; source, event and review dates remain historical.

states.name: New South Wales
states.researchStatus: Election review 29 October: Cobar nominations closed on 28 October at noon Sydney (AEDT); the poll remains scheduled for 28 November, with contest status awaiting confirmation. Coffs Harbour and Hunters Hill South Ward polls remain 12 December. Paul Amos resigned from Coffs Harbour Council effective 14 October. State Parliament composition retains its 23 October review; no full federal roster audit is claimed.

government.note: Labor is one seat short of a Legislative Assembly majority and governs with crossbench support.

elections.label: 2027 NSW State election
elections.note: NSWEC timetable updated 19 October: polling 13 March 2027, 8 am–6 pm Sydney time. Nominations open 15 February 8 am and close 24 February noon; early voting starts 6 March. Postal receipt closes 25 March at 6 pm.

strategyNotes: NSW is the first large-state countdown on the portal, with the election scheduled well before Brisbane 2032.
The lower house is close enough that trust, named crossbenchers and crossbench agreements matter in plain public language.
The upper house already behaves like a negotiation chamber, which makes it useful for simulator rehearsal.

states.name: Queensland
states.researchStatus: Scoped review 23 October: official 20 October Parliament roster confirms 93 seats and unchanged party totals; Stafford member Luke Richmond remains Labor. Historical Stafford percentages retain their July check. Tablelands Mayor Kevin Cardew and Townsville Division 1 Michelle Hobson verified from current council sources. Tablelands Division 1 is vacant: postal ballots must be completed by 31 October 6 pm and received by 10 November 5 pm Brisbane time. Other council/federal coverage remains partial.

government.note: Queensland has a single chamber. Stafford was retained by Labor at the 16 May 2026 by-election.

strategyNotes: Queensland is the home-base page for the Brisbane 2032 runway.
The unicameral system makes local electorate trust and member accountability especially important.
The Stafford by-election (held 16 May 2026, Labor retain) is the worked example for refreshing seat data after any by-election.
